notes: Background: mid-market B2B product analytics SaaS, feature: in-app conversational guide + doc search. Evaluating Hosted API for speed to market then Dedicated for production economics and compliance.
Trial summary (Hosted API): ran a 4-week trial across staging + limited prod (beta). Instrumented via SDK and server-side proxy.
Observed traffic (hosted trial): avg QPS 8, 95th percentile QPS 42 during release window, typical concurrency 6, peak concurrency observed 22 (spike on 2026-02-18 release).
Token mix (trial): 65% chat/completions (avg 120 tokens/prompt), 25% embeddings requests (avg 750 tokens/doc), 10% reranking requests (avg 350 tokens).
Daily token volume (trial week): ~450k tokens/day baseline, spiked to ~1.8M tokens on release day (short burst, ~6 hours).
Latency targets: product wants P50 < 50ms (non-stream), P95 < 200ms; streaming ttf (first token) < 60ms for interactive flows.
Current ask: sizing guidance for Dedicated to support steady growth to QPS 150, sustained concurrency 60, and burst to 300 QPS for short windows; estimate reserve capacity + burst pool.
POC goals: validate 95th latency SLO on Dedicated, confirm cost per 1M tokens with batching and KV caching, evaluate autoscaling/burst behavior and failover to Hosted tier.
Model preferences: prefer open/quantized LLM family with verified perf profile; want option for smaller low-cost reranker and larger chat model; fallback routing required.
Security notes: require SSO/SAML integration, KMS for keys, audit logging to SIEM, retention controls (30/90/365 day toggles), and EU data residency for some customers.
Quote requests: asked for a 12-month reserved capacity quote with monthly billing + a separate pay-as-you-go burst pool. Need sample contract language for data residency and support hours.
SE notes: recommend 2 mid-sized GPU nodes (dedicated) as starting point + 1 hot burst slot; suggested config notes attached (see Drive pricing pdf). Will refine after traffic forecast review.
Customer feedback: 'Latency is our #1 user complaint; cost is second — want predictable bills and a clear migration path from Hosted to Dedicated.'
Commercial: procurement team asked for TCO comparison (hosted vs. dedicated) and an ARR estimate with committed discount tiers.
Internal: waiting on SOC2 evidence doc (security asked 2026-03-05). Legal asked to see SLAs for failover and data residency — provided sample earlier.
Engineering concerns: caching strategy (prefix caching + KV reuse) will heavily affect token consumption; they plan to use embeddings cache to reduce calls by ~40% for search traffic.
Pricing sensitivity: mid-market — wants entry dedicated tier that covers 80% of baseline but can burst to 3x for launches without exponential cost.
Requested deliverables: 1) Dedicated sizing worksheet (QPS -> GPUs -> expected token throughput), 2) Sample committed pricing, 3) Runbook for failover from Dedicated -> Hosted.
Quote/POC timeline: requested demo follow-up week of 2026-03-15, want sizing deliverable by 2026-03-20 to present to finance on 2026-03-25.
Stated decision criteria: latency SLO adherence, predictable monthly cost, security compliance (SOC2 + SSO), clear rollback/fallback policies, and support response times.

Notes about routing: want policy to route low-cost embeddings to cheaper quantized model, chat to mid-tier model, and reranking to a specialized reranker; automatic fallback to Hosted if Dedicated limited.
Misc refs: demo recording (ff-2026-02-21-0317), notebook with telemetry sample (link attached in Drive).
